summary: Frees the sub-resources of an audio resource object (buffers at a2+28 and a2+36, plus flag/pointer fields at a2+44 and a2+48) selected by a state flag at this+0x13DC. When the flag is set, buffers are freed directly with FreeWrapper_7bcf. When clear, the object at a2+28 is first released through a virtual release and the object at a2+36 through a draining-loop finalizer, then both are freed. Returns 0 on both paths.

operations.description: Branch on the state flag at this+0x13DC: set selects the direct-free path, clear selects the virtual-release teardown path.
Direct path: when the buffer at a2+28 is present, free it with FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Direct path: when the buffer at a2+36 is present, free it with FreeWrapper_7bcf, and zero the resource fields at a2+28, a2+36, a2+44 and a2+48.
Virtual-release path: reset the object at a2+28 through its virtual release routine.
Virtual-release path: finalize the draining loop for the object at a2+36.
Virtual-release path: free the buffers at a2+28 and a2+36 with FreeWrapper_7bcf.
